description: I launched my campaign on Martin Luther King, Jr. Day, because the American Civil Rights Movement has been such a deep inspiration in my life. I got involved in nonviolent action because of the example of former Congressman John Lewis. My wife and I named our daughter, Ella, after the great civil rights leader, Ella Baker. title: Why It Was an Honor to Get Arrested
